description: Quote claiming rewards. 'send' pays them to the owner; 'compound' swaps them into the position and requires slippage. The returned `rewards` feed build_claim. Returns a quote envelope; `expiresAt` is unix ms and quotes expire after 180 seconds. Amounts are base-unit integer strings.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance as a decimal: 0.005 means 0.5% (not 1e18 fixed-point)

name: quote_claim
title: Quote claim
